english.note: Use this when “salad” refers specifically to salad greens or raw salad vegetables as an ingredient rather than to the prepared dish.

examples.english: I bought some salad greens; I’ll make a salad tonight.
examples.traditional: 我買咗啲沙律菜，今晚整沙律。
